phase_prompt.summary: The Moon begins to fill with light in mathematical increments. It is a waxing crescent or gibbous, but the light looks like a fluid or data-stream filling a container.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Hyper-realistic medium shot of the Waxing Moon. The obsidian disc is partially illuminated by a sharp, crescent-shaped pool of cold white light. The light appears to be contained within the glass surface, possessing a thick, plasma-like quality. The boundary between light and dark is razor-sharp, highlighting the artificial nature of the celestial body. The unlit portion is sleek black glass, reflecting faint atmospheric details. High contrast, drama lighting, iso 100.
